first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and prior onboarding simplification improved early adoption in SMB/self-serve accounts. Verify the original records before testing a guarded simplification, while measuring qualified revenue and retention to ensure improved activation translates into sustainable value.

mid.rationale: Run a small guarded test of shortened onboarding, prioritizing self-serve accounts where completion and activation are currently weakening. The verified result showed completion +13%, time-to-value reduced by 2.1 days, and 30-day retention +3%. Signup simplification also supports activation gains in SMBs, but its 30-day retention decline and limited segment generalization warrant guardrails. Measure activation, qualified revenue, and 30-day retention before scaling.

final2.rationale: Run a tightly targeted, time-limited offer for demonstrably price-sensitive SMB accounts facing active churn risk, rather than broad discounting. Prior evidence supports acquisition and revenue lift but shows materially worse 30-day retention, so gate expansion on qualified revenue and retention, with clear stop conditions for downstream value erosion.
